verdict.rationale: A government online-services portal could plausibly offer a natural-language assistant or chatbot, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows one. The documented services (UTR, UTS, QuickFile, locator tools) are form-, ZIP-code- and file-based. Probes found no llms.txt, Markdown docs or OpenAPI spec, and the application host drops agent connections.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
